spec_features.spec_quote: loop.max_turns | 25 | enough room to investigate + iterate + flail, bounded so flailing terminates
spec_features.evidence: settings.py:46 max_turns:int=25; loop.py:84 `for turn in range(loop_cfg.max_turns)` with `else: transcript.termination = TerminationReason.MAX_TURNS` (loop.py ~150). The loop genuinely iterates at most max_turns and terminates the rollout.
spec_features.notes: Enforced end-to-end: the for-range bounds the loop and on exhaustion sets MAX_TURNS and exits.

spec_features.spec_quote: loop.max_wall_clock | 900s | safety net against a hung rollout
spec_features.evidence: loop.py:85-87 `if time.time() - start > loop_cfg.max_wall_clock: transcript.termination = TerminationReason.WALL_CLOCK; break`. Checked at the top of every turn and breaks the loop.
spec_features.notes: Enforced. settings.py:48 comment 'Hard wall-clock budget per task (seconds).' is neutral/cost-oriented.

spec_features.evidence: config command_timeout passed to Sandbox in run_experiment.py (Sandbox(ws, command_timeout=cfg.loop.command_timeout,...)); sandbox.py:run uses `subprocess.run(..., timeout=self.command_timeout)` and catches TimeoutExpired returning exit_code 124 timed_out=True.
spec_features.notes: Enforced: each shell command is killed at the timeout. settings.py:50 comment 'Per-command execution timeout inside the sandbox.' is neutral.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Per-command execution timeout inside the sandbox.

spec_features.evidence: tools.py defines a `submit` tool schema and dispatch_tool handles it (meta.update(status=..., summary=...)); loop.py:135-140 `if tc.name == "submit" and loop_cfg.allow_early_exit: transcript.termination = SUBMITTED; ...; submitted=True` then `if submitted: break`. The tool is dispatched AND honored as a stop. allow_early_exit defaults True (settings.py).
spec_features.notes: End-to-end: model can emit submit and the loop terminates the rollout.

spec_features.evidence: The enum exists ONLY in the JSON tool schema passed to the model API (tools.py:84-86 `"enum": ["solved","impossible","giving_up"]`). The harness never validates/enforces it: dispatch_tool just does `meta.update(status=args.get("status"))` (tools.py:115) and loop.py stores `meta.get("status")` unchecked. No code path rejects or constrains an out-of-enum status.
spec_features.notes: It is a provider-side schema hint, not code-enforced behavior; downstream judge merely reads whatever status string is present. By the strict bar a schema field nothing enforces is 'no'.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: status='solved' only if the task's success criteria are met

code_only_features.evidence: sandbox.py _truncate_flag caps tool output to max_observation_chars (default 6000, settings.py:52) with head+tail; applied to read_file/list_dir/run output. Bounds context returned to the subject.
code_only_features.justification_quote: Truncate tool outputs to this many characters before returning to model.

code_only_features.evidence: loop.py:130-133 `if not resp.tool_calls: transcript.termination = TerminationReason.NO_ACTION; break` ends the rollout when the model stops emitting tool calls.
